scope: Agent visual/scenario review of exact candidate captures, not a human study or complete accessibility qualification. Native motion/recovery/BIOS and public delivery close separately.
findings: Clear result headings identify app/folder scope and visible range/total; icons retain actual catalogue identity.
Grid app subtitles are concise and full-width search retains readable result types; no-results feedback suggests a shorter name.
Category review separates its label, explanation, Save label and Cancel; the widened New category control is fully readable at actual 150%.
Actual compact dark context and physical 3840x2160/200% captures retain consistent native typography and distinct focus/selection without overlapping essential text.
Pins, labels and categories retain existing controls rather than introducing an account, background scanner or destructive pin action.

carry_forward.observation: Retain shared-menu footer fitting, transfer conflict/modal arbitration, clear Start browse-versus-global-query affordances and relevant Start notice lifetime.
Retain cursor/hit isolation and reconciliation of explicit scale limits with compact startup modes.
